newsitem.title: USA: Silicom wins account from original equipment maker.
newsitem.headline: Silicom wins account from original equipment maker.

text.p: Silicom Ltd said it won a major account from an original equipment manufacturer in the United States.
Silicom did not identify the customer or disclose terms of the account.
It said it began deliveries to the customer -- a producer of mass storage peripherals -- during the fourth quarter with a shipment of 500 units of its EtherSerial PC Card product.
The company said the new account will improve its financial results for the coming year, although did not specify by how much.
The company could not be immediately reached to comment further.
